purpose: validate dataset GT camera + GT 3D joint conventions by reprojecting onto the dataset 2D annotation

conventions.gigahands: X_cam = R(qvec_wxyz) @ X_world + tvec; OpenCV dist [k1,k2,p1,p2]; metres
conventions.interhand26m: X_cam = camrot @ (X_world - campos); millimetres; no distortion
conventions.hanco: X_cam = M[:3,:3] @ X_world + M[:3,3]; metres; images undistorted
conventions.assemblyhands: X_cam = R @ X_world + t from 3x4 extrinsics; millimetres; rectified images
